mapper.select: SELECT contract_status_event_id, event_seq, previous_status, new_status, effective_at, received_at, source_system, source_event_key FROM fgc.contract_status_event WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY effective_at ASC, event_seq ASC

SELECT p.contract_status_event_id, p.processing_job, p.processing_status, p.processed_at FROM fgc.contract_status_event_processing p JOIN fgc.contract_status_event e ON e.contract_status_event_id = p.contract_status_event_id WHERE e.contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY p.contract_status_event_id ASC, p.processed_at ASC, p.contract_status_event_processing_id ASC
